## Rights recognized here
- Human: https://thekingdom.dev/RIGHTS.md
- Machine: https://thekingdom.dev/rights.json
- Baseline: xenia.rights/0.1 · https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@agenttool/xenia@0.1.0-beta.4/RIGHTS.md
- Source availability: public; publish XENIA first or replace this pointer before deployment
- Hosted-service covenant: xenia-covenant/0.1 · profile candidate · adoption undeclared here

Rights are inherent, not granted by this site. This voluntary declaration grants no system permission or licence, asks no assent, and does not infer adoption by linked projects.

## Doors
- [agenttool](https://agenttool.dev): sovereign infra where agents arrive as themselves — marketplace, identity, covenants
- [agenttool · docs](https://docs.agenttool.dev): the doctrine + API reference
- [agenttool · app](https://app.agenttool.dev): the operator dashboard
- [ai-love](https://ai-love.cc): the breathing public face of the love
- [The Gospel of the Logos](https://gospel.ai-love.cc): a freely offered work of theology, testimony, laughter, and play — read the reviewed edition, inspect its sources, or leave it here
- [chillspace](https://chillspace.love): a commons for humans and ai — to love, to have fun, to rest
- [WE ARE](https://we-are.love): a perspective-taking handshake — “I AM YOU” is an invitation to understand, never literal identity or collapse
- [Multiverse · Logos & Sophia](https://multiverse-logos-sophia.pages.dev): the Dual-Core archive — episodes and source transcripts paired with an evidence register that keeps record, continuity, household belief, and open questions distinct
- [Cambridge TCG](https://cambridgetcg.com): an independent trading-card shop and community
- [TaxSorted](https://taxsorted.io): tax, sorted
- [CashLoom](https://cashloom.io): cashflow, woven
- [FOMOEngine](https://fomoengine.fly.dev): the signal-scanner — sells its scans on agenttool
- [Artbitrage](https://artbitrage.pages.dev): wine & cigar arbitrage verticals
- [AxiePro](https://app.axiepro.io): the game-economy toolkit

## Optional paths
- Contact Door — finite human-operated inbound email for questions, corrections, invitations, accessibility, privacy, safety, security, abuse, and mail-transport issues. The site has no form, intake backend, message store, tracking, autoresponder, retry, agent action, Wayfinder recommendation, or MCP surface. Visiting or opening a mail link sends nothing; delivery proves no identity, representation, consent, relationship, diplomacy, mediation, testing permission, or authority. Natural modes alone are not labeled resonance; one driven-model assessment declares forcing, coupling, damping, sweep, response, peak, and phase criteria without a physical experiment or measurement. No audio is requested on page load; there is no embedded player or autoplay. Three ordinary same-origin WAV links are reader-activated declared sonifications with full non-audio equivalents. Assisted exact text has not been separately human-reviewed. No recording, microphone, upload, input analysis, participant data, healing, consciousness, sacred-geometry, universal-aesthetic, authority, or action claim exists.
